chunks: And Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah narrated to me from his father 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Abi 'Abdillah, from his father, from someone who narrated to him, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from his father, from Hakim ibn Jubayr, who said:

I heard Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) saying: 'An angel descends every night carrying three mithqals of musk from the musk of Paradise, and casts them into the Euphrates. There is no river in the East or in the West [in the East and in the West] greater in blessing than it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the Euphrates River according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) narrates that an angel descends nightly to drop musk from Paradise into the Euphrates River, granting it superior blessing compared to all other rivers in the East and West. This highlights the spiritual merit and purity associated with the Euphrates.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 7. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh narrated to me from his father ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ‘Abdillāh, from his father, from someone who narrated to him, from Ḥanān ibn Sadīr, from his father, from Hakīm ibn Jubayr, who said:

‘Ali ibn Ḥusain (Imam Sajjād (a.s.)) said: Every night an angel comes down and drops three particles of musk from the musk of Paradise in the Euphrates River. There is no river more blessed than the Euphrates (River) anywhere in the east or the west.
